parsed.internal_thinking: Charlie is gloating about my sheep being blocked while he collects wood. I have 3 wood and 3 sheep, but no brick to expand. He's trying to get under my skin after he already betrayed me. I'll remind him that his brick port is useless without the brick he's currently lacking.
